description: This Java class defines the entity 'ProvisioningCriteriaDefinition' for the Fineract project, representing provisioning criteria details such as age ranges, provisioning percentage, and associated accounts. It includes methods for creating, updating, and checking overlaps between provisioning criteria definitions.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaDefinition
classes.description: Entity class representing provisioning criteria definitions with properties such as age range, provisioning percentage, and associated accounts, along with utility methods.

methods.name: newPrivisioningCriteria
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ProvisioningCriteriaDefinition with specified parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the provisioning criteria definition with new age ranges, percentage, and account references.

methods.name: isOverlapping
methods.description: Determines if this provisioning criteria overlaps with another based on age ranges.
